About

Crafting worlds
players remember

I'm misa — a Roblox level designer and 3D environment artist specializing in creating immersive, gameplay-driven worlds. From serene sakura temples to dark floating voids, every map is built with purpose and atmosphere.

My process combines environment storytelling with player flow optimization, ensuring every space feels both beautiful and functional. I work across a wide range of styles — fantasy, urban, horror, and beyond.
